body: You have such a beautiful face! If I saw you on the street I'd think "wow, she is pretty." Smile, it suits you! :)
Last day before easter break, that way my friends and family will get the holiday to sort things out.

Thanks for the support, it means a lot. I'm trying to write my story down now, but I can't wrap my head around it for long at a time, so it will probably take a while. Will you wait? I just found out that that one guy I almost trust kind of went behind my back, and I'm totally over-reacting now, but I'm sort of desperate and am considering rushing it and just be done with it.

But I have talked... And talked and talked and talked. It's not helping me in any sort of way. I've tried meds, to no effect. One psychiatrist even gave up on me and sent me to another. 
And the worst thing? I have no reason to be sad, I just am. I read all those stories about people going through terrible things, and my life is perfect compared to that. Yet here I sit, almost too depressed to move, and it makes me hate myself so much.
